blocks.text: Hello — this is Stratum running in replay mode. This response is authored, not produced by a live model. Questions, parliamentary replies, reports and topics still run against the real library; only plain conversation is replayed.

Stratum reads coal documents into verified facts and answers from them. Ask a question about production, offtake or targets and every figure comes back with its source cell; paste a Lok Sabha or Rajya Sabha question and it drafts the reply with annexures and flags any figure that differs from what was told to Parliament before; ask for a report and it writes a Word document; ask for topics and it shows what the library is about. This response is authored for replay mode.
